game_title: Call Stack Tower – Frosted Chapel Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round, snow wraiths strike the sleigh, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the sleigh from snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel: keep the stack_height meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: stack_height drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
